ww-spaghetti.identity: Barilla Whole Grain Spaghetti, US one-pound dry package
ww-spaghetti.conversion: Each rounded label value multiplied by 100/56. Use labeled 56 g, not exact oz conversion, for nutrition. Physical 16 oz pack uses existing mass conversion independently.
ww-spaghetti.yield_basis: Whole dry pasta is usable. Weigh dry, cook by absorption and retain all cooking liquid; no cooked-volume yield or added water nutrients. Manufacturer identifies the dry one-pound package; retailer supplies 2 oz (56 g), eight servings. No trim or discarded liquid assumed.
ww-spaghetti.limits: Manufacturer ingredient statement and macro panel agree with mapped retailer panel. Retailer warns possible egg cross-contact despite manufacturer free-from text, so egg exclusions conservatively reject. Other package cross-contact remains unverified; no safety certification. Actual package may differ. No displayed price imported. Recipes are internal preparations, not kitchen tested.
